name: phase2.5-llm-provider-benchmark
notes: Same 20 queries are run against every provider. English/Hindi supported queries come from real MSMARCO-XI queries whose passages are in the indexed sample; unsupported and low-relevance queries are deliberately outside the sample.

what is barter system and its problems
